//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	privatehttp "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/diagnosticfixture"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root launches this finite provider only against its newly prepared test DB.
// The three questions are the published, curated Course smoke fixture, with
// fresh content identities. This proves registered owner HTTP/PG behavior;
// it makes no AI authoring or content-generation claim. Rows remain for root
// readback and disposal of the dedicated database; append-only facts are kept.
func TestT18ServeDiagnosticCourseHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T18_SERVE_COURSE") != "true" {
		t.Skip("owned T18 Course provider gate absent")
	}
	ready, stop, result := os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_STOP_FILE"), os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_RESULT_FILE")
	token, catalogToken := os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_CATALOG_TOKEN")
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	host := os.Getenv("T18_ATTESTED_POSTGRES_HOST")
	if err != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t18_course_test" || host == "" || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != host || net.ParseIP(host) == nil || token == "" || catalogToken == "" || token == catalogToken || ready == "" || stop == "" || result == "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact owned Course configuration required")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{ready, stop, result} {
		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: metadata and stop paths must be absent")
		}
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Course pool unavailable")
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	var database string
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database()`).Scan(&database) != nil || database != cfg.ConnConfig.Database {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact Course DB unavailable")
	}
	// Root prepares canonical references. The provider does not insert or mutate
	// shared reference data or an already existing fixture.
	for _, language := range []string{"en", "ru"} {
		var n int
		if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM i18n WHERE language=$1`, language).Scan(&n) != nil || n != 1 {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: Course language reference missing")
		}
	}
	var n int
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM code_structure_type WHERE id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000f900' AND code=$1`, domain.CodeStructureTypeTestSingleChoiceBasic).Scan(&n) != nil || n != 1 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: canonical Course quiz reference missing")
	}
	definition, err := diagnosticfixture.LoadDefinition()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: curated definition unavailable")
	}
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM course WHERE slug=$1`, definition.Slug).Scan(&n) != nil || n != 0 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: fixture slug must be unoccupied")
	}
	namespace := "t18." + uuid.NewString()
	definition.IDs = diagnosticfixture.IDs{Course: uuid.NewString(), Module: uuid.NewString(), Section: uuid.NewString(), Lesson: uuid.NewString()}
	for i := range definition.Tasks {
		item := &definition.Tasks[i]
		item.ID = uuid.NewString()
		item.SourceKey = namespace + ".task." + item.ID
		for j := range item.Tests {
			q := &item.Tests[j]
			q.ID = uuid.NewString()
			q.SourceKey = namespace + ".question." + q.ID
			for k := range q.Variants {
				v := &q.Variants[k]
				v.ID = uuid.NewString()
				v.SourceKey = namespace + ".variant." + v.ID
			}
		}
	}
	lessons, tasks, targets, tests, structures := LessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskLearningTargetRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskTestRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CodeStructureTypeRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	provisioner := diagnosticfixture.Provisioner{Definition: definition, Dependencies: diagnosticfixture.Dependencies{
		Tx: TxManagerPG{Pool: pool}, Courses: CourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CourseI18n: CourseI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, I18n: I18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CodeStructures: structures,
		Modules: ModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool}, ModuleI18n: ModuleI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, CourseModules: CourseModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Sections: SectionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, SectionI18n: SectionI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, ModuleSections: ModuleSectionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Lessons: lessons, LessonI18n: LessonI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, SectionLessons: SectionLessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Tasks: tasks, TaskI18n: TaskI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}, TaskTests: tests, LearningTargets: targets}}
	fixture, err := provisioner.Ensure(ctx)
	if err != nil || fixture.Status != "created" || fixture.CourseID != definition.IDs.Course || len(fixture.Assessments) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual curated Course provision failed")
	}
	structureUC := task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: lessons, Tasks: tasks}
	structure, err := structureUC.Handle(ctx, fixture.CourseID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual Course structure missing")
	}
	catalog, err := structure.DiagnosticOnly()
	if err != nil || catalog.CurriculumRevision != fixture.CurriculumRevision {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual Course catalog mismatch")
	}
	handler := &privatehandlers.TaskHandler{GetDetailsUC: task.GetTaskDetails{Tasks: tasks, TaskTests: tests, TaskFiles: TaskFileStorageRepoPG{Pool: pool}, LearningTargets: targets, Structures: structures}, GetInternalCourseStructureUC: structureUC}
	registered := chi.NewRouter()
	lessonHandler := &privatehandlers.LessonHandler{GetUC: lesson.GetLesson{Lessons: lessons}}
	registered.Mount("/internal", privatehttp.NewRouter(handler, lessonHandler, nil, nil, token, "", catalogToken))
	server := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(registered)
	server.Config.ReadHeaderTimeout = 5 * time.Second
	server.Config.ReadTimeout = 40 * time.Second
	server.Config.WriteTimeout = 40 * time.Second
	server.Config.IdleTimeout = 5 * time.Second
	server.Start()
	defer server.Close()
	defer server.CloseClientConnections()
	metadata := map[string]any{"url": server.URL, "course_id": fixture.CourseID, "curriculum_revision": fixture.CurriculumRevision, "catalog": catalog, "fixture_version": 1, "namespace": namespace, "classification": "actual registered Course diagnostic catalog and trusted task definitions; curated three-question fixture, fresh owned IDs; no AI authoring claim"}
	t18CourseWriteExclusive(t, ready, metadata)
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("owned Course 20-minute deadline exceeded")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, err := os.Stat(stop); err == nil {
				t18CourseWriteExclusive(t, result, metadata)
				return
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
				t.Fatal("owned Course stop read failed")
			}
		}
	}
}
func t18CourseWriteExclusive(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe Course metadata encoding failed")
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path+".tmp", os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive Course metadata creation failed")
	}
	_, writeErr := file.Write(append(raw, '\n'))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe Course metadata export failed")
	}
	if os.Link(path+".tmp", path) != nil || os.Remove(path+".tmp") != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive atomic metadata publication failed")
	}
}
